name: forgeathon-editor
description: VS Code editor client for the Forge-a-thon TrueForge agent.

forge.trueforgeUrl.description: Local TrueForge server in the extension host environment.

forge.mcpPort.description: Loopback port used by the editor MCP server.

forge.context.semanticSearch.description: Use local semantic reranking (CPU) only when keyword/structure evidence is weak. Waits up to 200 ms, then uses the lexical/structural shortlist while local vectors continue warming. Optional runtime: run scripts/enable-semantic-search.sh (about 230 MB); the model (about 54 MB) downloads on first use. Set false to disable.

forge.autoApproveSafeCommands.description: Run the agent's test and status commands without asking: only pytest, python -m pytest, git status and git diff, with no shell operators. Each one is shown in the panel as "auto-approved". Every other command (including python -c and flask) and every edit still asks.

forge.commandBudget.agent.description: Most commands the agent may run in one turn (asked or auto-approved). Further run_command calls are refused by the harness without asking, and the panel shows "command budget reached".

forge.commandBudget.inline.description: Most commands an inline edit may run in one turn (the inline agent does not run commands today).
